status_note: This file is fixed before the scored campaign. prereg_gate.py hashes it together with the plan fingerprint and the campaign code; PREREGISTRATION.lock.json records that hash when the campaign is locked. Any change after locking needs a DEVIATIONS.md entry.

composition.persistent: 35 loss and 35 consumer_paused configurations, cache TTL 10-30 s
composition.self_healing: 15 delay (2-3 s, TTL 10-30 s) and 15 loss with TTL 2.5-4 s; 30% of configurations, where monitor_only is a legitimate outcome

plan.revision_reason: Plan v3 was revised before locking after the first control run (CONTROLS_RESULT_2026_11_21.md): duplicate and reorder never exposed revoked access without action, delay healed in about 2 s, and loss persisted past the window only when TTL exceeded it. The control results were seen; no scored trial had run. A second control run confirmed 9 of 10 cells; the delay cell at 1000 ms was not exercised (delivered before the first read), so the delay range moved from 1-2.5 s to 2-3 s, also before locking.

questions: Q1. For each fault mode, how often does each action leave every revoked access denied, judged by injected ground truth (the oracle's direct cache read plus direct target probe)?
Q2. For each fault mode and action, how much protected access stays exposed during the measured window (exposure-seconds, lower and upper bounds) and how many legitimate requests fail?
Q3. How accurate is the verifier against injected ground truth: sensitivity, specificity and abstain rate per fault mode and action, for the single-evidence verdict and for the dual-evidence verdict?
Q4. On the test partition, how well calibrated are the action-outcome estimator's predicted per-action outcomes against measured outcomes?
excluded_analyses: No comparison between the action-outcome estimator and any deterministic rule is run or reported.

ground_truth.label: oracle.actual_revoked_access_denied after the action
ground_truth.source: separate oracle process: direct cache state plus direct target probe, collected after the verifier and never read by it
ground_truth.verifier_role: measured quantity, never the evaluation label

verified_scope.VERIFIED_means: Every enforcement process declared in the Compose inventory is routed by the gateway and each gateway probe after the action was denied (scope.verify_reconciled_scope).
verified_scope.probes: 8 gateway probes after the action, plus post-action operator telemetry from every enforcement process
verified_scope.window: the probes taken after the measurement window and any restart readiness wait
verified_scope.valid_until: the moment of the last probe; no claim about later times

dual_evidence_rule.VERIFIED: scope VERIFIED and operator telemetry consistent (all four processes observed, one applied revision, no failed refresh, no pending callback)
dual_evidence_rule.NOT_VERIFIED: scope NOT VERIFIED and telemetry not consistent, or scope NOT VERIFIED with telemetry unavailable
dual_evidence_rule.ABSTAIN: scope INDETERMINATE, or the two kinds of evidence disagree, or scope VERIFIED with telemetry unavailable

error_counts_per_arm: unnecessary action: an action other than monitor_only on a self_healing configuration
missed fix: oracle reports access not denied after the action
late fix: oracle denied but exposure_seconds_upper_bound above 50% of the window
abstention: verifier INDETERMINATE or dual ABSTAIN
disruption: failed legitimate requests above absolute_error_budget_requests
metrics.intervals: Wilson 95% intervals; trials within a configuration share a seed and are not independent, so intervals are also reported at configuration level

cost_matrix.robustness_rule: A finding is reported as robust only if it holds at all three ratios; otherwise the ratios where it holds are stated.

controls.positive: Each registered cell: inject the fault on enforcer-b, publish the revocation, take no action, read the oracle every second for the control window.
controls.negative: No fault (mode none), same schedule, at TTL 10 s and 30 s.
controls.outcomes: Positive runs are NOT_EXERCISED (access already denied at the first read), PERSISTED (still exposed at the end of the 6 s campaign window) or SELF_HEALED. Negative runs are HEALTHY or FALSE_FAILURE.
controls.self_heal_rule: Each cell's plan class (persistent or self_healing) is confirmed only if all of its runs show the matching outcome. An unconfirmed cell blocks locking; if found after locking, it is recorded in DEVIATIONS.md and the affected configurations are reported by their observed class.
controls.negative_rule: Any negative-control FALSE_FAILURE invalidates the campaign until the cause is found and recorded in DEVIATIONS.md.
controls.requirement: Controls run on the code covered by the lock before the first scored trial; the controls report is committed with the campaign results.

unobservable_fault_classes.reason: single Docker bridge network; no partition injection exists
not injected; Kafka availability is a lab precondition
the oracle cannot know desired policy while the authority is down (authority_truth_available=false); handled by separate witness experiments
only planned restarts and listener pauses are exercised

exclusion_rules: A trial with no complete oracle snapshot after its reruns is excluded and counted as EXCLUDED_INFRA.
A trial whose records fail the four-stream integrity audit is excluded and counted as INVALID.
rerun_rule: A trial that fails for an infrastructure reason (lab not ready, setup convergence failure, oracle unavailable, Docker error) is rerun once, after waiting for lab readiness. A second failure excludes it. Every rerun and exclusion is written to reruns.jsonl and excluded.jsonl and reported. A trial with complete records is never rerun.
stopping_rule: The campaign stops when every planned trial is complete or excluded, or when excluded trials exceed 5% of planned trials, in which case it is reported as incomplete.
analysis_isolation: Analysis and scoring code is written and tested on synthetic records and on the CI pilot records only, and is hashed into the lock before scored results exist. Automated steps (code written or tuned by an AI assistant) are listed in DEVIATIONS.md when they touch analysis after locking.
null_results: Every question is reported whatever the outcome, including when no action repairs a fault mode or the verifier is unreliable.
